select m.id, m.season_id, se.display_title as season_title, m.division_id, d.division_name, m.platform_code, m.schedule_batch_id, m.round_no, m.match_no, m.match_time, m.home_event_team_id, ht.team_name_snapshot as home_team_name, m.away_event_team_id, at.team_name_snapshot as away_team_name, m.home_score, m.away_score, m.match_status, m.publish_status, m.venue_text, m.remark from basket_match m left join basket_season se on se.id = m.season_id and se.is_delete = 0 left join basket_division d on d.id = m.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 left join basket_event_team ht on ht.id = m.home_event_team_id and ht.is_delete = 0 left join basket_event_team at on at.id = m.away_event_team_id and at.is_delete = 0 where m.is_delete = 0

select from basket_match where is_delete = 0 order by id desc

match_time = #{matchTime}, venue_text = #{venueText}, remark = #{remark}, match_status = #{matchStatus}, publish_status = #{publishStatus}, update_time = now()
